news.title: Deehwalian Gazette holds journalism ethics training
news.description: Campus reporters took part in a journalism ethics training led by guest speaker Ms. Rica Mae Macawile, revisiting the responsibility and purpose of student journalism.

news.title: DeeCORE Multimedia Society recruitment
news.description: DeeCORE invited students interested in video editing, scriptwriting, graphic design, digital illustration, and content engagement to join the multimedia society. This recruitment deadline has passed.

news.title: Dear Deehwalians: a space for kind words
news.description: The Student Council launched an anonymous NGL dropbox for wholesome messages, encouragement, and appreciation. Students are encouraged to keep every message kind and respectful.
news.imageAlt: Student Council announcement for the Dear Deehwalians message dropbox

news.title: Bote Para Kay Teacher brings voting and recycling together
news.description: The Student Council and YES-O invited students to vote for their favorite teachers by donating plastic bottles ahead of Teachers’ Day, combining recognition with environmental awareness.
